thread:
Sam K.: Heads-up: Vendor (CloudX) issued a $24k rebate for committed GPU usage but it didn't show up on the March invoice. Billing export shows credit_received = 0 for account redwood-hosted-prod.
Aisha T.: Oof. Do we have the vendor credit ID? Might be applied to a different billing account by mistake.
Sam K.: Vendor email: credit id CX-REB-2026-03-17. I pulled BigQuery: ```SELECT billing_account_id, SUM(cost) as invoice_cost, SUM(credit_amount) as credits FROM `billing.gcp_export_v1` WHERE invoice_month='2026-03' GROUP BY billing_account_id``` Result: credits=0 for our primary acct, credits=24,000 for a partner onboarding acct.
finance-bot: Invoice mismatch alert: expected external rebate not applied to primary billing account (delta $24,000).
Diego L.: That partner acct is the CloudLabs POC we spun up for pilots. Vendor probably used the POC account when issuing. We need to reconcile and request reallocation of the credit to our prod acct or get a new credit transfer.
Aisha T.: Policy question: if we reassign the credit, should it offset customer billings (ACME/Enterprise) or internal committed spend first? Historically we apply rebates to offset vendor costs before customer invoice adjustments.
Sam K.: For March customer invoices that are already closed, we prefer to treat as an internal credit and reflect in April accruals. If ACME is entitled under contract we might pass through but need Sales signoff.
Diego L.: Sales (cc: @SalesOps) confirmed no pass-through for this rebate. OK to apply rebate to internal GPU cost bucket and adjust monthly cost allocation.
Aisha T.: Good. I'll open FIN-5178 to request vendor to reissue or transfer credit and to update our billing export mapping. We also need a short runbook so vendor team doesn't credit wrong acct.
Sam K.: Drafted the vendor email and ask: include CloudX reference + billing_account_id redwood-hosted-prod. Vendor-ops can send?
vendor-ops: I'll escalate to CloudX billing. Expect reply within 48 hours. If they won't transfer, CloudX offered an account-level invoice credit; we'll accept and finance will move the credit via internal journal entry to the committed GPU cost center.
Aisha T.: Approving internal journal path as fallback. Please include GL codes: 5602 (Vendor rebates) and 4201 (GPU committed cost) on the JE request.
finance-bot: Created ticket FIN-5178 and scheduled follow-up: 2026-04-05.
Sam K.: Thanks. Action items: (1) vendor-ops escalate and confirm transfer or invoice credit (2) finance prepare JE if needed (3) tagging: ensure CloudX references use metadata field vendor_credit_id in our vendor reconciliation table.
Diego L.: I'll add the vendor_credit_id check to the onboarding checklist so future POCs don't get credited by mistake.
Aisha T.: I'll update the chargeback mapping once credit reflects. TIA.
